batting.name: HC Brook
batting.dismissal: st N Pooran b Ravi Bishnoi

batting.name: Washington Sundar
batting.dismissal: c DJ Hooda b A Mishra

batting.name: AU Rashid
batting.dismissal: c DJ Hooda b A Mishra

batting.name: KH Pandya
batting.dismissal: c Anmolpreet Singh b Umran Malik

balls.text: full and fast outside off. Samad looks to hit it over extra cover but fails to connect
this one just sits up. Short outside off, Samad waits for it before launching it over deep midwicket
short outside off. Looks to cut it away but ends up hitting it into the ground
Banged in short outside off. Samad goes for the pull but it doesn't bounce much and goes underneath the bat
short of length angling across. Samad waits on the back foot and smashes it over long-on. That was bowled at 117.5kph, so Samad had to generate all the power himself
full and wider outside off. Dragged towards wide long-on. Malik charges back for the second but Hooda throws it on the bounce for Unadkat to break the stumps. Malik was well short
Mishra picks up his second. Tossed up outside off, 78.5kph. Rashid looks to clear long-off but hardly any power on it. Hooda walks in a couple of steps and accepts it
flatter on the stumps. Adil was forward but looks to flick it away. Misses and gets hit on the pads
full outside off once again and Adil hits it over extra cover, between long-off and deep extra for four
tossed up on the stumps, looked like a googly. Washington's eyes lit up as he looks to clear long-on. Not enough power behind that and Hooda takes at the boundary line
tossed up outside off and spinning away. Samad drags the slog sweep towards square leg
too full outside off. Hit along the ground to the right of long-off. Only a single
short of length outside off. Looks to force it down the ground off the back foot but gets an inside edge that rolls towards fine leg, allowing Samad to come back for the second
length ball cramping the batter. Pushed towards long-on. 100 up for SRH
length outside off. Steered towards deep cover
too short and Samad pulls it between deep square leg and deep midwicket, bisecting the gap for four

short of length outside off. Tripathi looks to ramp it over short third but there's hardly any pace available to execute that shot. Ends up hitting it to the left of Mishra who dives full length to grab it with both hands
starts with a short ball. Pulled towards deep midwicket for a couple
tossed up outside off. Goes for the slog sweep but misses as the ball turns away. The keeper can only get a glove on it, resulting in one bye
length but way too outside off. Tripathi brings out the reverse hit and goes over point for a much-needed four
another googly on the pads. Flicked towards deep square leg
too short again, just outside off. Tripathi rocks back and pulls it hard but straight towards long-on. Just a single
short of length outside off, slow turn. Cuts it towards backward point
a googly, full on the leg stump. Flicked in front of square leg
length ball on the stumps. Defended on the front foot
quicker one at the stumps. Defended from the back foot
length ball on the stumps. Washington bends his back knee and pulls it towards deep midwicket
length outside off. Cuts it towards backward point but fails to beat Bishnoi once again
length outside off, cuts it towards backward point, straight towards the fielder
length ball outside off, pushed towards cover-point
Bowled from the front of the hand, full on the stumps. Too full, I feel. Tripathi comes forward and hits it over the bowler's head for four
length ball on the pads, flicked towards deep midwicket
goes inside out and chips it over covers. Only a single though
goes for the sweep but the ball comes way too slow off the surface. Gets an inside edge onto the pads that rolls just behind the keeper
length ball on the stumps, punched back. Mishra fumbles a bit but no run taken
full on the stumps, looked like a googly. Pushed down the ground for one
length ball on the stumps. Was looking to work it towards midwicket but ends up pushing it much straighter. Bishnoi moves across to make the stop
length around off. Drops it towards covers and hares down the other end
another fast googly. Slightly fuller this time. Washington goes for the drive but is beaten once again
length ball outside off, 93.4kph. Was a googly that kept going on with the arm to beat the outside edge
length outside off, pushed towards cover-point for a quick single
length outside off. Goes back and whips it behind square leg

full but down the leg side. Needs to be bowled again. Oh, wait. LSG want to review this call. No bat involved and it was well down the leg side. So LSG lose their review. It was a good take by Pooran, though
a googly. Slightly shorter in length. Goes back and pulled towards deep midwicket
full outside off, pushed towards extra cover
length outside off. Goes back and cuts it towards cover-point
full on the stumps. Goes for the sweep and gets an inside edge towards short fine leg
Beauty! Length, just outside off and spinning away to beat the drive. Was bowled from wide of the crease. A big puff of dust came off from where the ball landed
full outside off. Driven towards sweeper cover off the front foot
length ball outside off. Pushed towards mid-off for a quick single
short, at the batter. Pulled towards deep midwicket
short of length outside off. Looks to cut it away but it goes under the bat. Thakur had rolled his fingers over it
length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards deep cover
length ball around off, punched back towards the bowler
short of length on middle and leg. Pulled towards deep square leg
full on the stumps. Comes forward and pushes it towards cover

a googly but pitched outside leg. Washington looked to flick but misses and was hit on the pad. The ball rolls towards covers. Tripathi was looking for a single but had to undo his steps as Washington was unmoved
full on the stumps, flicked towards deep midwicket
short of length outside off. Mistimes it into the ground towards extra cover
full on the pads, flicked towards midwicket
length around off. Looks to punch through the off side but gets an inside edge towards short fine
a boundary after a while. Too much room this time and Tripathi beats the diving point fielder on his right
length outside off. Cuts it towards point - little room to free the arms
length outside off. Pushed towards long-off
length ball outside off. Goes for the sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball rolls towards square leg
length ball outside off. Worked towards midwicket
length ball outside off. Pushed towards covers

stumped! By a mile. Brook uses his feet once again but Bishnoi has bowled it slightly shorter and outside off. Brook was nowhere near the pitch of the ball. Looks to push at it but gets beaten on the outside edge. An easy stumping for Pooran
quicker one, 100.5kph. On a length around off and middle. Brook defends it from the back foot
down the track and hits it past non-striker. Didn't middle it though. A couple to long-on as Shepherd jogs to his left to make the stop
a googly from well outside off. Tripathi comes forward and opens the face to work it behind point for one
length ball on the pads, flicked towards deep midwicket. Off the mark
length ball on the stumps. Goes back and punches it towards deep midwicket

and he has been bowled first ball. Was fired in around off, fuller than good length. Markram went for the drive but the ball spins away just enough to beat the bat and hit the outer half of the off stump. SRH in trouble, and Krunal will be on a hat-trick at the start of his next over

An appeal for lbw and given out. Faster one - 98.6kph - on middle and leg. Anmolpreet was looking to work it on the leg side but gets beaten and pinged on the back leg. Just above knee roll. He has once again reviewed it and the ball-tracking shows it was just clipping the leg stump. So it's umpire's call and Anmolpreet will have to walk back
full, angling towards the pads. Tripathi stays leg side of the ball and pushes it towards extra cover
length ball at the stumps. Goes back to cut but cannot beat backward point
full outside off. Goes for the sweep but misses and is hit on the pads
length ball around off. Anmolpreet looks to go over the bowler's head but ends up getting a leading edge straight down the ground. Krunal runs back but it lands well away from him
short of length on the stumps. Another googly, it looked like. Punched towards long-on
another googly, much better line this time. Starting from outside off. Rahul was looking to hit it towards covers but gets an inside edge behind square leg
a googly. Short of length and coming in towards middle. Punched towards deep midwicket off the back foot
too full outside off. Tripathi goes hard but ends up hitting it towards deep cover
short of length outside off. Keeps low. Tripathi was looking to punch it off the back foot but fails to get the timing right. Ends up hitting it back towards the bowler
starts with a short ball on the pads. Pulled towards deep square leg
short of length outside off. Drags a pull towards deep midwicket
too full on the stumps, 140.8kph. That's not the way to bowl on this pitch. Anmolpreet flicks it through midwicket for four
short of length outside off. Mistimed back towards the bowler

short but keeps low. And given lbw. Anmolpreet has reviewed it, though. Anmolpreet went for the pull but the ball sneaked underneath the bat and hit him on the back thigh. The only questions is the height. And yes, it was going over the middle stump. So Anmolpreet survives
looks to repeat the shot but this time Thakur has bowled it really full. Tripathi, who was looking to scoop, somehow manages to squeeze it towards square leg
short outside off but it's a slower one - 119.1kph. Tripathi moves across and scoops it over short fine leg - his first boundary
back-to-back boundaries. Goes down on one knee and lofts it over backward square leg for another four. After just one runs from the first four ball, SRH pick up eight from the last two
length ball around off and middle but Anmolpreet nails the timing and placement this time. Punches it to the right of Mayers at mid-on for four
quicker on the stumps this time. Pushed towards mid-on
length ball on the pads. Misses the flick and gets hit on the pads
once again targeting the stumps with a length ball. Comes slightly slower off the surface. Tripathi backs away and forces it towards long-off
length ball on the stumps. Defended from the crease
114kph. Short of length outside off. Anmolpreet slaps it towards mid-off. Little timing, though
another slower one - 117kph. Banged in short but angling away outside off. Called a wide
length ball around off. Pushed towards mid-off for another quick single
length ball around off. Steered straight towards Hooda at point this time
length ball, just outside off. Dabbed towards backward point. Hooda charges towards the ball to prevent the single
length ball around off. Punched to the left of mid-off for one
a grubber. Good for Anmolpreet that it was well outside off. Pitched on a good length and went almost parallel to the ground. In fact, it just rolled to the keeper after passing the stumps
length ball at the stumps, quicker through air from Krunal. Tripathi was caught on the back foot but manages to get his bat down in time. The ball kept just a little bit low as well
taken at extra cover. On a good length outside off, and Mayank went for the drive on the up. Ended up hitting it in the air. Stoinis leapt and took it overhead with both hands
length ball on the stumps once more. Worked in front of square leg once more
length ball on the stumps, flicked towards deep square leg
length but on the leg stump this time, was sliding even further down. Mayank goes down and hits a half-pull half-sweep over square leg. Yash Thakur with the chase but cannot stop the boundary
length ball around off and middle. Pushed back towards the bowler

first six of the night. Slightly shorter from Unadkat this time, in the line of the stumps. And Anmol pulls it over fine leg. A bit of top edge but it clears the boundary with ease. Smashes into the manual scoreboard
length ball around off. Pushed towards mid-off for another quick single
length ball around off. Hits it towards mid-off and sets off. For a moment, it looked like Anmolpreet could be in danger, so he puts in a dive to beat the attempted direct hit
length ball on the stumps. Anmolpreet looks to go hard but mistimes it towards short midwicket
length ball on the stumps and Anmolpreet picks it up over square leg. The fielder in the deep runs to his left to keep it to two. Looked like Unadkat had rolled his fingers over it
length ball outside off. Hits it on the up towards cover
length ball around off. Anmolpreet stands tall and punches it towards wide long-on. The mid-on had just moved there
length ball around off. Stays back and pushes it towards mid-on
length. Once again on the pads but not much bounce this time. Flicked towards deep square leg for one more
length outside off. Comes in off the pitch to hit the batter on the thigh. Anmolpreet was looking to flick it on the leg side. They pick up a leg-bye
length outside off, pushed towards covers for a quick single
stars with a length ball that started from outside off and came in. Flicked behind square leg for one

flings over deep backward square! LSG win comfortably, with five wickets and four wickets in the bank. A massive hit to end the game. Fuller side of a length around off, and Pooran thrashed it away across the line. LSG win a low-scoring game
high full toss on the stumps, and pushed wide of mid-off after charging down the pitch
flashes at this good length just outside off, and finds extra cover
change of pace. Shortish just outside off, and pushed back to the bowler
length ball wide of off, and driven to deep point away from his body
punches at this good length ball angled into off, but gets an outside edge to deep third
turns in off a shortish length, and ends on middle and off. Nudged to short midwicket
full and slower on off, and defended towards short third
keeps low off a good length, ending outside off after turning away, as Pooran punched and missed
looks to paddle sweep, and gets four behind the wicket as the ball lobs off his top edge. Full and outside off, heading away further from the left-hander

given out again, and reviewed again! Now this one was a big-turning googly after he got Rahul with a legspinner. This also looked like heading down leg, as Rashid bowls on a good length on off, only for the ball to end on leg stump. Shepherd was playing on off stump, with a massive gap between bat and pad, with the latter around leg. And guess what, it is umpire's call on clipping the top of leg. That was great turn there

given out leg before wicket, as Rahul misses his reverse sweep! That looked plumb to the naked eye, but hang on... Rahul has reviewed even as he is walking back. Length ball ball flicked from the front of the hand on leg stump, as it turned away to end around middle. Rahul reverse swept but swung his bat early, with the ball passing his bottom edge. No bat involved there, as he is struck on what seems to be middle stump. Yup, that would have smacked the middle stump, and SRH get a consolation wicket
makes room, and even skips down. But the ball is shortish and angling into leg, as Stoinis dabs it down
good length ball angled in, and ends just outside off. Punched to mid-off
low full toss angled into the stumps, and just pushed between the stumps and the non-striker. Just uses the pace on the ball, as he hardly even moves his front foot there
shorter side of a length on middle. Nudged to mid-on
very full and on the stumps. Flicked to short midwicket
drives at this good length ball on sixth stump. Single to deep point
he is almost squared up by this shortish ball on middle, which straightened after pitching. Dabbed down though
goes quite full, but wide of off. Left alone by Stoinis
good length ball on off, and nudged to midwicket
now tickles this behind the wicket! Malik bowled on a good length again, angling it in while again pitching on the leg side. A little guide off the inside half of the bat by Stoinis
five wides again. Good length ball pitching on leg, and darting down the leg side further, as the keeper dived to his left but couldn't get a hand

outside edge, and the keeper takes it low to his left! Good length ball angled into the left-hander from around the wicket, and was very slightly wide of off. Pandya looked to fence that away, but got an outside edge, as the 149kph ball seemed to rush on to him
sliced over mid-off! Pandya's good day continues. He slogs through the line, as this length ball arrives around off, and he uses the pace of the bowler to go over the top
good length on off, and nudged to short midwicket off the inside half of the bat as Natarajan took pace off
length ball angled in, and driven from outside off to extra cover
fires a yorker on off, which Pandya squeezes out to deep third after moving around in the crease before the ball was bowled
shorter side of a length, ends on off after being angled in. Punched to long-off, as they raise the fifty stand
good length ball just outside off, and pushed to deep extra cover as it angles away after pitching since it's a slower ball. They nab two, and that is great running
punches this good length ball just outside off to deep point, as he backs away early
good length on off, and punched to mid-on's right. Markram dives and hits the stumps at the bowler's end, but Pandya is in
pulled wide of mid-on! Markram gives the chase up as he nears the rope. Short ball banged outside off, and ending on off, as he swivels to pull hard

the keeper's bad day continues, though this wasn't very easy. Length ball darted in, and ending outside leg, as Pandya missed his flick. The keeper dived to his right and got a glove, off which the ball trickled away
much fuller on off, and pushed to mid-off
good length ball angling in to end just outside off. Pushed back
shortish in length on off, and punched wide of mid-off
shorter side of a length, angling into middle and leg. Dabbed to short extra cover
flicked to fine leg, as he gets across, and sees this full ball angling into his pads. They pinch two, as Agarwal slides to his left to cut that off
extra cover fielder dives forward, but can't collect it cleanly. Shortish ball around off, and swatted by Pandya
slower ball, and full n off. Tapped to point
now Pandya gets across, and Natarajan bowls on a good length, angling it down leg. Wide called
makes room, and punches this length ball on middle and off to deep point. And, and... Malik there runs to his left, and lets the ball through below his left hand
full delivery, angling into off. Driven back to the bowler
another fumble by the keeper, and that is a bye again. Good length and wide of off, as Rahul tried to slash but missed
fired down the pitch! Pandya comes out with clear intent: go for it fearlessly. Again he skips out to get to the pitch of this length ball around off, and bashes it over the bowler's head for six
turns in and keeps low off a good length outside off. Bunted back off the bottom edge
fended off the outside half of the bat to cover, as he pushes at this full ball on off
full on the stumps, and defended off the inside edge, with the ball dribbling towards square leg
turns away off a length from outside off, and is pushed to deep point
full and slow on off. Tucked to cover's left
full and straight, and nudged to midwicket
again jumps out, and goes inside out over cover to deep extra cover, as the ball is fullish on off
outside edge, and off the keeper's right knee. Full ball going on with the angle, and ending outside off, as Rahul pushed at it
Bhuvi at point dives to his left to get a hand, as this short and wide ball outside off was hacked by Krunal
drilled to deep extra cover! Skips out and makes a bit of room to this full ball on the stumps, and hammers it to extra cover's right
length ball just outside off, and tapped down off the bottom edge
gets an outside edge wide of slip, as he drives at this full ball which is tossed up on off
much slower to Rahul, and fullish and wide of off. Left alone
bowls slower, and on a length outside off. Hints to turn away, and is dabbed to point
good length ball on off, and tucked to long-off
turns away to finish outside off from a short of a length, and Rahul punches to deep extra cover. Not a great length there, as Rahul waits for it to come before pushing it away
fullish ball a bit wide of off. Turns away, and is flat-batted to deep backward point

great catch by Bhuvi! No reaction at all from the bowler despite nabbing it one-handed to his left. Bhuvi had to tumble to his left to grab that low, as he stuck his left hand out. He bowled what seemed like a legcutter on a good length on off, with Hooda jumping out again. Hooda ended up fending at it, and giving Bhuvi a catch. SRH fighting here
gets across early, and Bhuvi goes full while angling it into middle and off. Nudged to the leg side
goes for a flashy drive to this good length ball on sixth stump, but is beaten
slower ball. On a good length, hinting to angle into middle. Tucked to cover
full and on off, and defended down
oh, what a shot! Attacks Bhuvi right away. That follow-through was brilliant: he skipped down to this fullish ball outside off, and lofted with the full face of the bat to go down the pitch
keeps low off a good length, as it angles in to end just outside off, and past Hooda's inside edge as he looked to push. Anmolpreet tumbled forward, but couldn't collect cleanly, and so LSG had a bye
good length ball around sixth stump. Hacked to deep point
length delivery angled into off, and pushed wide of mid-off
just passes leg stump... and is called wide. Looked like a harsh call, as it was a good length ball pitching around leg, which Hooda missed after trying to clip

taken at deep square leg! Some relief for SRH finally. It's a huge boundary there, and Mayers found the only fielder in the deep on the leg side. It was the third pull shot of the over from Mayers, who saw another good length delivery fired at him. He pulled it hard and flat too, but the boundary was too big for the ball to land beyond it
good length just outside off, as Mayers pulls again but is beaten
Mayers gets across off early, as Farooqi bowls short while angling into middle. He pulls but it hit his thigh
much fuller and straighter, and driven to long-off
short and wide-ish of off. Finds point with his slash
very full just outside off, and he lofts to long-on off the inside half of the bat
paddle swept over short fine! Full ball around off, and he gets down to swing his bat for four
good length and on off. Again finds midwicket
short and turning in. Clipped to midwicket
change of pace again, as this length ball just passes off stump, with Mayers missing his drive

short third fielder - Malik there - looked interested at once, but gave up in the end, as the ball trickled to his right. Slower ball on a length, angling into off, as Mayers opens the bat face to guide that ball to deep third
gets a bottom edge close to his front foot, as he looks to slash at this good length ball angling away to end on sixth stump
this keeps a bit low off a good length after pitching on middle and leg, and angling across. Dabbed down with the lack of bounce
good length again, angling across to finish on off. Pushed to cover
shorter side of a length on middle. Clipped to short midwicket
good length ball angling in, and hitting his pad but outside leg
four more, and LSG are racing already! Sees this full ball outside off, and just uses his bottom hand to place it wide of the extra-cover fielder, and away from long-off's reach
full and just outside off. Nudged to long-on, as they keep ticking
shortish and angled in. Punched aerially to long-off
nearly a yorker on middle, and pushed to long-on
driven wide of mid-off! Too full, and wide enough outside off for him to drive that between extra cover and mid-off. The ball was drifting away, but Rahul drilled at it

walks down a step, and flicks it very high. The ball lands on the bounce to deep square running forward and a bit across. Fullish ball on middle, and Mayers went lashing at it, only to get off the bottom of the bat
this keeps low off a full length on fifth stump, as Mayers looks to push but the ball shoots through
guides this good length ball which is wide of off to deep third
five wides while defending a low total. Full ball angling down leg, and ending quite wide, beating the diving keeper too
crisply drives between short cover and cover-point! Fullish delivery just outside off, as he takes a good stride forward and presents the full face of the bat
another one darts back in off a good length, finishing on middle stump. Pushed halfway towards mid-on
on a good length, angling it back into leg from middle, as Mayers clips but is hit high on his pad
